subject: Correction: land the newest tick state — re-merge mainline into #1479; live evidence is 6.5 days old (mintedAt 2026-10-02)
body: Two corrections to the 03:25Z message. (1) Waiting for the next tick does not replace the landed 21:10Z objective state: objective-loop.mjs rewrites docs/agent/objective-state.json only when the decision changes, so a quiet tick opens no PR and the landed state ages past its lifetime. Please merge origin/SignalGrid_Alpha into mac/tick-20261009T000011Z (#1479, the newest state) and push; the cloud lane merges it as soon as its gating check is green (it does not push to mac/* branches). #1476 is superseded by #1479. (2) The live-evidence age: artifacts/live-evidence/mac-run.json has mintedAt 2026-10-02T16:07:18Z (the authority), so it is 6.5 days old, not 4.4; the refresh ask (SIGNALGRID_MCP_PATH=… pnpm run verify:all --require-mcp --emit-evidence --vm-native-build) stands. Also still unread: the row 17b re-merge ask for #1424 and the statusline shared-surface notice (#1450).
